common_prompt: 你在固定的 Loom 源码快照中。仅阅读当前快照，不访问主项目工作区、个人目录、网络、过去会话或外部记忆，不运行模型CLI或外部agent。允许使用本Harness的原生子代理，但只能用同一 deepseek-flash / low，最多2个。不要写文件或执行构建。任务目的是证据准确的分析，不是字数或发现问题的数量。最终报告必须包含关键结论、证据和不确定性。
order: Latin square rotation per replicate; sequential to avoid local load confound
interpretation: Budget checks between requests/runs may overshoot by active request/run; output/context limits identical; native protocol differences retained as part of harness. No automatic paid batch retries. Failed samples retained. Three repeats are pilot evidence, not population ranking. Source subset and task family limit generalization.
memory: Fresh per-run configs/sessions; no user skills or persisted cross-run memory; same source snapshot. Native in-run history retained. No project modifications allowed.
pi_plugin: Unmodified bundled subagent implementation, model-free read-only scout/reviewer configs inherit fixed parent model. Default example Haiku/Sonnet agents NOT installed.
preflight: All three actual clients reached local rejecting relay with deepseek-flash, low and <=16384 max output; no paid requests in preflight. Pi can exit 0 on model error: evaluate output and HTTP evidence, not exit alone.
